seo.description: Write queries, edit data, inspect schemas and move data between files and databases. Explore TablePro's free and paid features.

header.title: Features
header.lead: What TablePro does on Mac and Linux, area by area, across the databases it supports.

areas.summary: Write SQL with autocomplete that reads your schema, keep the queries you reuse, and read query plans on supported engines.
Filter rows, follow foreign keys and edit in the grid, with the SQL to review before anything is saved.
Change table structure, read ER diagrams, and compare two databases before syncing them.
Import {importFormats} files, export tables and results, and edit data files without a database.
Use the AI provider you choose, and let AI clients work with saved connections through MCP.
Reach private servers through SSH and tunnels, sign in with your cloud account, and import connections from other apps.
Sync connections through iCloud, share them as files, and publish connections and queries to your team.
